# External request

State the outcome you want.

## Outcome

What must be true when the work is done?

## Constraints

What must the work leave unchanged? Name any limit.

## Context

Where should the reader look? Name files, issues or facts that already exist.

## Acceptance intent

How will a reader know the outcome is met?
